# Test Inputs for AI Parsing
# Format: input text -> expected result type

## English Calendar Events

Meeting tomorrow at 2pm
-> calendar_event (simple)

Lunch with Sarah at Downtown Cafe on January 28th at noon
-> calendar_event (with location)

Conference from February 1st to 3rd at Convention Center
-> calendar_event (all-day, multi-day)

Team standup at 9am and client call at 2pm tomorrow
-> multiple calendar_events

## English Reminders

Remind me to buy milk
-> reminder (simple, no due date)

Submit the Q4 report by January 30th at 5pm
-> reminder (with due date and notes)

URGENT: Call doctor tomorrow morning at 10am
-> reminder (high priority with due date)

Buy groceries (milk, bread, eggs), pick up dry cleaning by 6pm, and pay electricity bill by Jan 30
-> multiple reminders

## Mixed English

Project review meeting on Jan 29 at 10am in Room 305, and prepare presentation slides by Jan 28
-> calendar_event + reminder

## Chinese Calendar Events

明天下午3点开会
-> calendar_event (simple)

1月28日中午12点和Sarah在市中心咖啡馆吃午饭
-> calendar_event (with location)

2月1日到3日在会议中心参加会议
-> calendar_event (all-day, multi-day)

## Chinese Reminders

提醒我买牛奶
-> reminder (simple)

1月30日下午5点前提交Q4报告
-> reminder (with due date)

紧急：明天上午10点给医生打电话
-> reminder (high priority)

## Mixed Chinese

1月29日上午10点在305会议室开项目评审会，1月28日前准备好演示文稿
-> calendar_event + reminder

## Ambiguous Cases

Meeting at 2
-> ambiguous (which day? AM/PM?)

Need to finish the report
-> ambiguous (calendar event or reminder? when?)

Call John
-> ambiguous (reminder or event? when?)

## Edge Cases

Tomorrow
-> ambiguous (what to do tomorrow?)

3pm
-> ambiguous (what event at 3pm?)

Buy milk and meeting at 3pm tomorrow
-> mixed (reminder + event)

## Empty/Invalid

asdfghjkl
-> empty (random text)

123456
-> empty (just numbers)


-> empty (whitespace only)
